title: Marketing to Chinese Tourists in 2023 - Where Are They Going?

facts.fact: China scrapped its zero COVID policies at the end of 2022.
facts.quote: After China scrapped its zero COVID policies at the end of 2022, 2023's Lunar New Year's holiday marked the first major holiday in three years without pandemic restrictions in China.

facts.fact: In 2019, Chinese tourists made 170 million trips, contributing 254 billion USD to the global economy.
facts.quote: In 2019 alone, they made 170 million trips, contributing 254 billion USD to the global economy.

facts.fact: According to COTRI, the full recovery of Chinese leisure tourism will likely begin only in the second quarter of 2023.
facts.quote: The full recovery of leisure tourism will likely begin only in the second quarter of 2023.

facts.fact: According to a Fitch Ratings 2023 analysis, Chinese tourists contributed roughly a third of all international tourists to countries like Vietnam, Thailand, and Korea in 2019.
facts.quote: contributing roughly a third of all tourists for countries like Vietnam, Thailand, and Korea.

facts.fact: In 2022, Chinese tourist numbers to most APAC destinations saw a tenfold decrease compared to 2019.
facts.quote: with 2022 seeing a tenfold decrease in numbers compared to 2019 for most APAC destinations.

facts.fact: According to Dragon Trail's 2022 consumer sentiment report, 69% of Chinese travelers received travel information from social media channels, the top source of travel information.
facts.quote: 69% of Chinese travelers received travel information from social media channels, ranking as the top source of travel information.

facts.fact: According to Dragon Trail's 2022 report, tour guides, embassy official channels, and foreign social media sites contributed 14%, 18%, and 22% respectively as sources of travel information.
facts.quote: tour guides, embassy official channels, and foreign social media sites contributed only 14%, 18%, and 22% respectively.

facts.fact: WeChat Pay allows users to book international flights and hotels without leaving the app, per the vendor's description.
facts.quote: With its e-wallet system of WeChat pay, users can book international flights and hotels without leaving the app

facts.fact: According to Dragon Trail's 2022 consumer sentiment report (as cited by HI-COM), the top two goals of Chinese tourists are trying local foods (60.8%) and experiencing local life (56.7%).
facts.quote: the top two goals of Chinese tourists are to try local foods and experience local life (60.8% and 56.7% respectively).

facts.fact: Alibaba-owned Fliggy, previously known as Alitrip, grew out of Taobao's travel booking service in 2014.
facts.quote: Alibaba owned Fliggy, previously known as Alitrip, grew out of Taobao’s travel booking service in 2014.

facts.fact: Trip.com Group became one of the largest OTAs worldwide after its acquisition of Singapore-based Trip.com in 2017, as stated by HI-COM.
facts.quote: after its acquisition of Singapore-based Trip.com in 2017

facts.fact: Chinese tourists were slowly re-entering the global tourism economy in 2023 after three years, according to HI-COM.
facts.quote: With Chinese tourists slowly re-entering the global tourism economy in 2023 after three years

facts.fact: HI-COM, a digital marketing agency, states it works with more than 100 brands.
facts.quote: Working with more than 100 brands, HI-COM is the go-to partner of companies that want to enter the China market!
